moments.title: Strictly's Glitterball Return
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its launch show this Saturday, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe, and Josh Widdicombe, and revealing celebrity-pro pairings live for the first time.

angles.name: New Era for Strictly
angles.copy: Strictly Come Dancing is back this Saturday! Get ready for a whole new era with Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe, and Josh Widdicombe taking the reins. Who are you backing for the Glitterball? #Strictly

angles.name: Live Pairings
angles.copy: This year's Strictly launch is shaking things up! Celebrity and pro pairings will be revealed LIVE for the first time ever on Saturday. Expect drama! #Strictly

angles.name: Meet the Cast
angles.copy: The 2026 Strictly cast includes Lacey Turner, Dani Dyer, Delta Goodrem, and Shaun Wright-Phillips. The journey begins Saturday 7:25pm on BBC One! #Strictly

moments.title: Bake Off's New Ingredient
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series next Tuesday, with a new judge, Nigella Lawson, joining Paul Hollywood in the tent.

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: Ready your spatulas! The Great British Bake Off is back on Tuesday with a brand new judge: Nigella Lawson! How do you think she'll fare alongside Paul Hollywood? #GBBO

angles.name: New Bake Off Series
angles.copy: Soggy bottoms, showstoppers, and a new judge! The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday at 8pm on Channel 4. Who's excited for season 17? #BakeOff

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Arrives
moments.blurb: The astronomical Autumn Equinox occurs next Wednesday, September 23rd at 01:05 BST, marking the official start of autumn and when the nights begin to be longer than the days in the Northern Hemisphere.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: It's official next Wednesday! The Autumn Equinox arrives, bringing shorter days and longer nights. Time to embrace those autumnal vibes! 🍂 #AutumnEquinox

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: Next Wednesday marks the Autumn Equinox at 01:05 BST. Get ready for cosy nights as astronomical autumn officially begins. What's your favourite thing about autumn? #FirstDayOfAutumn

moments.title: F1 Heads to Azerbaijan
moments.blurb: Formula 1 continues its 2026 season with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix taking place from September 24-26, following last weekend's Spanish Grand Prix.

angles.name: Azerbaijan GP
angles.copy: F1 is back this weekend! The Azerbaijan Grand Prix hits Baku's street circuit from Sept 24-26. Expect thrills and spills! #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

angles.name: Race Weekend Alert
angles.copy: Who's ready for another F1 race weekend? The Azerbaijan Grand Prix is coming up, delivering high-speed drama in Baku. Tune in! #Formula1

moments.title: Loreen's Wildfire Tour Hits UK
moments.blurb: Double Eurovision winner Loreen brings her 'Wildfire Tour' to the UK this week, with dates in Glasgow (Sept 24), Manchester (Sept 25), and London (Sept 26).

angles.name: Loreen Live
angles.copy: Eurovision queen Loreen is bringing her 'Wildfire Tour' to the UK this week! Catch her in Glasgow (Thurs), Manchester (Fri) & London (Sat). Who's got tickets? #LoreenLive

angles.name: Pop Powerhouse
angles.copy: Loreen is set to ignite UK stages with her Wildfire Tour! From Glasgow to London, this pop powerhouse is not to be missed. #Eurovision #PopMusic

moments.title: Cosmic Void Festival London
moments.blurb: The Cosmic Void Festival, celebrating metal and dark music, takes place in London from September 18-20, featuring a lineup of diverse artists.

angles.name: Metal Festival London
angles.copy: Calling all rock and metal fans! Cosmic Void Festival descends on London this weekend, Sept 18-20. Get ready for three days of heavy sounds! #CosmicVoid #Metal

angles.name: Dark Music Weekend
angles.copy: London's getting dark this weekend with Cosmic Void Festival. If you're into extreme and dark music, this is your spot! Sept 18-20. #RockFestival

moments.title: The Prat Pack at London Palladium
moments.blurb: Brian Conley, Shane Richie, Bradley Walsh, and Joe Pasquale unite as 'The Prat Pack' for a night of song, dance, and banter at the London Palladium on September 25-26.

angles.name: Comedy Supergroup
angles.copy: The ultimate supergroup of funnymen is hitting the London Palladium! 'The Prat Pack' with Brian Conley, Shane Richie, Bradley Walsh & Joe Pasquale on Sept 25-26. #LondonPalladium

angles.name: Legends of Entertainment
angles.copy: For a night of laughs and classic tunes, 'The Prat Pack' featuring entertainment legends Brian Conley, Shane Richie, Bradley Walsh & Joe Pasquale are at the London Palladium this weekend! #Comedy

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Race
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart, but HUGEL, Imael Angel & Ultra Naté's 'Movin' To The Sun' is a strong contender for #1 in the midweek update.

angles.name: Chart Battle
angles.copy: The race for UK Number 1 is ON! Sienna Spiro is holding strong, but 'Movin' To The Sun' is making a big push. Who do you want to see at the top this Friday? #OfficialCharts

angles.name: New Music Buzz
angles.copy: Dua Lipa's 'Training Season' is still climbing the charts, and new entries are shaking things up! What's your current favourite track in the Top 40? #NewMusic
